observations.body: A woman touches Jesus and is told her faith has made her well; Jairus is told not to fear but believe after news of his daughter’s death.
observations.label: Faith is named between long illness and sudden death

payload.posture: Read Mark 5:21–43 as evidence about faith, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The paired stories distinguish the woman’s action from the father’s response to devastating news.
